svg.title: Quality inspector — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as quality inspector, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A vernier calliper with opposed jaws checks the outside diameter of a circular manufactured part. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face.
